column1: # The red run: this tree's assertions against the engine the base ref holds,
# written whole by tests/red, which tests/run --record-assertions calls.
#   base  <ref>  <sha>  <engine version there>
#   run   <failed>  <passed>  <skipped>        lines counted, not the summary
#   <assertion name>  <times it failed>        failed names only
#   an assertion the manifest lists that the base run never reached counts as failed, by its shortfall
# A base of - means no complete red run was made: none was possible, the
# suite stopped before reached or reached no assertion, or tests/red itself
# was stopped; its stdout said which unless it was the one stopped.
# Reproduce with: tests/red <ref>
base
run
--status over a run whose loop ended on its second row says it reported 1 of 3 rows
--status over a short run says a receipt over it would be indeterminate
a check whose producer outruns grep -q, the match on its first line, is done
a count that comes back empty still leaves six tokens
a count that reads ? gives indeterminate, not commissioned
a full run over a short run says the receipt was written indeterminate

a full run whose loop ended on its second row says it reported 1 of 3 rows

a pipeline whose first stage fails and whose last succeeds is done, as in a probe

an output that carries a row twice the table lists once is not complete
an output whose rows are those the table lists, in another order, is not complete
